newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm, buyers and sellers stay divided.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm, buyers and sellers stay divided.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices remained firm on Friday although tight prompt avails and specific grade, date and delivery point buying interest continued to leave buyers and sellers devided, traders said.
However, most saw prices for reforming grades starting to come under pressure as poor margins limit demand from refiners.

The 60kt Algerian cargo that has been on offer all week at cif high +$3 may now be taken transatlantic according to the holder Petrobras after failing to find buyers at a suitable level. Buying for LVN barrels was also around cif high +$3 but offers were scarce and N+A valued around cif high +$2 cif NWE.
